title: The Eight Paths and the Cross of Light
description: T83 maps twelve ways through the complete circuit of states the soul passes through: four are chosen, reckoned among what is the Lord's, ascending toward life — by these the doctrinal vessels travel, and along them falsity is itself withdrawn. The other eight are the ways of corruption that draw the soul down into the lowest state of the natural: lawlessness, the killing in every body, the wounding word that strikes against truth as it suffers, blasphemy that mocks the Lord. T84 expounds how the four elemental faculties of the natural, when they come inward into the body, leave behind defiled garments — wrath beneath self-binding, desire beneath wrath, bitterness beneath desire, hatred, flesh, gloom, severity, the eightfold ways at the floor. In the regenerated body these are stripped, refined, and brought to the first rest; in a soul that goes on claiming, transmigration follows.
